meta.name: plate, washer, screw
meta.note: a standard M6 socket head screw on a washer in an M6 clearance hole. The hole and the screw come from the same table, so `interference` says clearance and the bill lists them by their standard names. (A washer does not fit a counterbore: ISO 7089 is 12 across, ISO 4762 counterbores are 11.)

mates.note: a fastened mate meets the two faces centre to centre, and the hole is in the middle of the plate, so this alone puts the washer over the hole
